'''Dan Lyman''' is an American journalist known for his involvement in conspiracy theories and association with controversial media figures. Lyman has garnered attention for his work that often aligns with far-right ideologies, frequently appearing on platforms that promote conspiracy theories. His work includes contributing to discussions on various unfounded and debunked conspiracies, which has led to significant debate and criticism.

Lyman's career became more prominent through his business connections with [[Alex Jones]]. Lyman has written for infowars.com and has made multiple appearances on Jones's platforms where he has discussed topics ranging from anti-globalization to immigration, often framing them in apocalyptic and conspiratorial terms. This association has raised questions about the legitimacy and motivations behind his journalism.
